label: 码头栈桥
description: 在单张区域掩码上按 point 生成一条从岸边伸进水里的栈桥。Point 吸附最近边界并推导局部外法线；桥身固定向岸内压入 4 格，避免与有机岸线断开，length 仍只表示向水面伸出的长度。末端可加宽成丁字头。电池直接输出专用 tagGrid：岸内端与外侧长边为开口，丁字头两个短边不打标、保留栏杆。outputGrid 已是合并后的整条桥掩码，下游只喂一个 grid2node。
description-en: Generate a point-positioned pier. The point snaps to the nearest boundary and determines a local outward normal. The deck overlaps four cells inland to prevent gaps at irregular shores, while length still measures only the outward run. An optional T-head is supported. A dedicated tagGrid marks the inland end and outer long edge as openings; the two short T-head edges remain rails.
icon: 俯视一条细长木栈桥从上方陆地伸入下方水域，末端加宽为一个小方形平台并有一个小圆点表示灯柱，扁平插画风格，主色2种。

inputs.name: inputGrid
inputs.label: 区域掩码
inputs.description: 单张可用区域掩码网格（每非零单元格视为陆地）；只用来找岸接线，结构可以长到掩码外。网格列表由引擎逐张 fanout。
inputs.description-en: Single region mask grid (non-zero cells treated as land); used only to locate the shoreline — the structure may grow outside it. The engine fans out a grid list one-by-one.

inputs.name: point
inputs.label: 接岸位置
inputs.description: 期望的接岸 point2d（x→列、y→行）。不在区域边缘时吸附到欧氏距离最近的 4 邻域边界格；伸出方向按吸附点附近的局部岸线自动推导。
inputs.description-en: Desired shore anchor point2d (x→column, y→row). If it is not on the region edge, it snaps to the nearest 4-neighbour boundary cell by Euclidean distance; the outward direction is inferred from the local shoreline.

inputs.name: width
inputs.label: 栈桥宽度
inputs.description: 栈桥垂直于伸出方向的宽度（格数），居中放置。同时作为 thickness 输出喂给 bridge_entry_tag。
inputs.description-en: Pier width in cells, perpendicular to the growth direction, centered. Also emitted as `thickness` for bridge_entry_tag.

inputs.name: length
inputs.label: 栈桥长度
inputs.description: 栈桥从岸接线沿伸出方向的长度（格数）。只被画布边界裁剪，不被岸线裁剪；岸边水面不足时会顶到画布边缘。
inputs.description-en: Pier length in cells from the shoreline along the growth direction. Clipped only by the canvas, never by the shoreline; it will hit the canvas edge if there is not enough open water.

inputs.name: capSize
inputs.label: 端头泊船平台长度
inputs.description: 端头泊船平台（丁字头）沿**垂直于桥向**的长度（格数）：把栈桥最外侧 min(桥宽, 长度) 格加宽成一条横条，总长仍是 length，不额外外伸。取值需大于桥宽才有效果，0 或 ≤ 桥宽表示不生成（纯直栈桥）。
inputs.description-en: Length in cells of the T-head mooring platform, measured **across** the pier's run: the outermost min(width, length) cells widen into a transverse bar, and the total length stays `length` without reaching further out. Must exceed the pier width to have any effect; 0 or ≤ width means no head (a plain straight pier).

outputs.name: outputGrid
outputs.label: 栈桥掩码
outputs.description: 单张多值网格：1=栈桥，2=端头泊船平台。已是合并后的整条桥掩码——直接接一个 grid2node.grid 建成单个节点。⚠️ 不要接 grid_split_by_value 拆成多个节点：preview 的 autotile 邻接判断只看本节点自己那一层，拆开会在交界处长出一圈假扶手。
outputs.description-en: Single multi-value grid: 1=pier, 2=cap. Already the merged bridge mask — wire it into one grid2node.grid to build a single node. ⚠️ Do not split it with grid_split_by_value: the preview's autotile neighbour probe only sees the cell's own layer, so splitting grows a ring of phantom rails along the seams.

outputs.name: decorGrid
outputs.label: 装饰点位
outputs.description: 单格 0/1 网格，栈桥最外端中心的装饰点位（灯柱 / 系船桩）。按物件摆放（asset_type=asset），不要当 tile 用——单格 tile 会在桥面上盖出一个孤立的 autotile 碎片。
outputs.description-en: A 0/1 grid with a single cell at the pier's outermost centre, for a lamp post / mooring post. Place it as an object (asset_type=asset), not a tile — a 1×1 tile layer paints an isolated autotile fragment on top of the deck.

outputs.name: tagGrid
outputs.label: 开口标签网格
outputs.description: 与 outputGrid 同尺寸；岸内端和外侧长边标为端头开口，丁字头两个短边保持 0 以使用栏杆贴片。接 grid2node.stateGrid。
outputs.description-en: Same size as outputGrid; marks the inland end and outer long edge as openings while leaving the two short T-head edges untagged for rail tiles. Wire to grid2node.stateGrid.

outputs.name: thickness
outputs.label: 桥宽（给端头判定）
outputs.description: 等于 width，接 bridge_entry_tag.thickness。由电池自己输出是因为端头判定必须知道桥宽，而下游拿不到 width；接死一个常数会在改宽度时失效。
outputs.description-en: Equals `width`; wire into bridge_entry_tag.thickness. Emitted by the battery because end-cap detection needs the bridge width and downstream cannot see `width`; hard-coding a constant silently breaks when the width changes.
